display_long_description:
Embark on an epic adventure in a vibrant and humorous world, where medieval history comes to life in a lively and colorful style. Tiny Clashers combines classic RTS strategy with a unique style that appeals to all ages.

Build and expand your kingdom from humble beginnings to vast empires and recruit a wide variety of unique units, such as infantry, archers, mounted knights, and catapults. Gathering resources with your villagers and managing them will be essential to maintaining and strengthening your faction, while defending your territories from enemy attacks or launching an epic assault against them.

The combat is not only exciting, but it also allows players to clash in epic battles on randomly generated maps, guaranteeing thrilling and surprising matches every time.

Are you ready to build your kingdom, lead your units, and conquer the medieval world with a touch of humor and fantasy? The fate of the kingdom is in your hands!
